role: reason and revelation; the fitra as innate knowledge of God
note: Darʾ taʿarud al-ʿaql wa-l-naql: his longest treatment of the fitra (that it is innate, that reason supports it, that messengers complete it)
al-Tamhid: the classic survey of the readings of 'every child is born on the fitra' and his own ('the most correct view': born sound, without faith or denial)
Shifaʾ al-ʿalil: a long chapter weighing the readings of the fitra hadith; also the decree and human acts
